text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Both your abilities and technique have 
improved dramatically since the first 
semester, and your desire for further 
growth is wonderful as well.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's not just us this time... 
Trainer had a change in mindset too. You 
could say it's the fruit of their 
guidance, right?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Change your mindset, and your actions 
change. Change your actions, and your 
results change. It's simple, but pretty 
tough without the right spark, y'know?
choice_data_list:
I'm really glad I went for an on-site 
inspection.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. While evaluation is naturally based 
on each member's ability, I'll be sure to 
include that as a comment in the report.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Starting in the new year, we'll transition 
our training to focus more heavily on the 
main BC event. Let's do our best!
